adj_ebitda_guidance.sentence: We expect to deliver between $2.4 and $2.6 billion of Adjusted EBITDA.
We reiterate our full-year outlook to deliver between $2.4 and $2.6 billion of Adjusted EBITDA.
Our aggregates business is executing well, and we reiterate our full-year outlook to deliver between $2.4 and $2.6 billion of Adjusted EBITDA.

projected_adj_ebitda_reconciliation.note: Q4-25 table shows Projected EBITDA of 2,500 with no adjusting items line (equal to Adjusted EBITDA mid-point).

Implied changes vs Feb: interest expense midpoint lowered to ~215 (from 225), tax to 340 (from 355); items in Adj. EBITDA 30 (H1-26 actual items: 28.5 = disc ops -0.3, loss on sale 13.2, divested ops 6.5, acquisition 0.5, CEO transition/reorg 8.6).

other_2026_expectations.metric: Aggregates cash gross profit per ton
other_2026_expectations.sentence: Continued improvement in Aggregates segment cash gross profit per ton ($11.33 in 2025)
Total shipments up 1 to 3 percent (226.8 million tons in 2025)
Freight-adjusted price improvement of 4 to 6 percent ($21.98 in 2025)

other_2026_expectations.metric: Aggregates freight-adjusted unit cash cost growth
other_2026_expectations.sentence: Low-single digit increase in freight-adjusted unit cash cost (freight-adjusted price less segment cash gross profit per ton; $10.65 in 2025)

other_2026_expectations.metric: Asphalt + Concrete segment cash gross profit
other_2026_expectations.sentence: Total Asphalt and Concrete segment cash gross profit of approximately $290 million ($322 million in 2025); excludes California ready-mixed concrete assets held for sale
other_2026_expectations.note: 2025 base of $322m includes the divested Houston asphalt business and California ready-mix; guidance excludes California ready-mix.

other_2026_expectations.metric: Asphalt / Concrete split of downstream cash gross profit
other_2026_expectations.sentence: Relative contribution of approximately 85 percent from the Asphalt segment and 15 percent from the Concrete segment
other_2026_expectations.note: Implied: Asphalt CGP ~ $246.5m, Concrete CGP ~ $43.5m (computed, not published).

other_2026_expectations.sentence: Selling, Administrative and General expense of $580 to $590 million ($564 million in 2025)

other_2026_expectations.note: Q2-26 projected reconciliation uses 215 for interest expense, net (no explicit sentence updating the guide).

other_2026_expectations.sentence: Capital spending for maintenance and growth projects of $750 to $800 million
Depreciation, depletion, accretion and amortization expense of approximately $700 million
An effective tax rate of 22 to 23 percent
Net earnings attributable to Vulcan of $1.1 to $1.3 billion

The construction environment remains supportive of continued aggregates price growth, and large projects and public construction activity continue to support our expectation for volume growth in 2026.
We anticipate that contributions totaling approximately $3.9 million to the funded pension plans will be required during 2026, and we do not anticipate making a discretionary contribution.
other_2026_expectations.note: Also: nonqualified plan contributions expected $3.8m in 2026; net pension expense $5.0m, net postretirement expense $3.7m.

other_2026_expectations.sentence: Returned capital to shareholders via dividends of $67.9 million at $0.52 per share versus $66.0 million at $0.49 per share
other_2026_expectations.note: Declared rate, not guidance; 6% increase vs 2025 ($2.08 annualized).

share_repurchases.note: No quantified 2026 share repurchase guidance found in the Q4-25/Q1-26/Q2-26 releases or 10-K/10-Qs.

Q1-26.sentence: the Company returned $217 million to shareholders through $149 million of common stock repurchases and $68 million of dividends.

Q2-26.sentence: Returned capital to shareholders via share repurchases of $250.3 million at a $276.69 average price per share

share_repurchases.authorization: February 2017 Board authorization of up to 10,000,000 shares; 3,864,057 shares remaining at 30-Jun-2026 (no dollar authorization).

houston_asphalt_construction.event: Asphalt mix and construction paving operations in greater Houston, TX sold in Q4-25; pretax gain $42.4m (in gain on sale; excluded from Adj. EBITDA).

proxies.sentence: The decrease in service revenues is attributable to the divestiture of our asphalt mix and construction paving operations in Houston, TX, during the fourth quarter of 2025.

proxies.item: Proceeds from sale of businesses FY2025
proxies.note: 9M-25 proceeds were 19.0 (Q1-25 West Texas aggregates sale), so Q4-25 proceeds of ~108.4 relate mainly to the Houston sale (derived).

houston_asphalt_construction.note: Vulcan did not disclose revenue or gross profit of the Houston business. Releases note prior-year asphalt results included it (Q1-26, Q2-26 releases).

california_ready_mix.event: Agreement signed Q4-25; held for sale at 31-Dec-25 (assets 708.5, liabilities 29.3: inventory 5.9, land 138.1, buildings/machinery 150.2, op leases 27.5, finance leases 6.2, amortizable intangibles 379.7, other 0.9). Sold early June 2026 together with US Virgin Islands aggregates/ready-mix for combined proceeds $722.1m ($572.1m cash + $150.0m note due Dec-2027); combined loss $13.2m.

proxies.item: 2026 downstream cash gross profit guide excludes CA ready-mix
Concrete segment Q2-26 included two months of CA ready-mix; DDA suspended while held for sale (Concrete DDA Q1-26 4.0 vs 15.4; Q2-26 3.9 vs 19.0)
Concrete segment (incl. CA ready-mix) 2025: revenue 846.6, GP 35.9, CGP 97.9, 4.5m cy; Q1-26: revenue 187.5, GP 10.2, CGP 14.2; Q2-26: revenue 186.8, GP 8.4, CGP 12.3

california_ready_mix.note: Revenue/GP of the California ready-mix business not separately disclosed. CA ready-mix largely came with Superior Ready Mix (acq. Dec-2024); Concrete segment remaining after sale is mainly Virginia/Maryland/DC (US Virgin Islands also sold).

debt_at_2026_06_30.facilities: $1,600m unsecured revolving line of credit maturing Nov-2029 (undrawn; $18.5m LCs; available $1,581.5m); $1,600m CP program backstopped by the revolver, nothing outstanding.
debt_at_2026_06_30.other: Feb-2026: paid $50.0m note payable to sellers of a 2022 acquisition (in other current liabilities at Dec-25). Mar-2025: redeemed $400m 4.50% notes due Apr-2025.
